checkpoint_inventory.prediction_rule: each checkpoint predicts ONLY its own fold validation identities

event_aggregation.description: For each event_id in an episode, event_score[head] = max(prob[head][known_mask & event_id==eid])
event_aggregation.rationale: Any step within an event window that crosses threshold signals detection. Max is the most sensitive choice for recall-oriented gating.
event_aggregation.threshold_note: Sigmoid midpoint = 0.5; symmetric and not data-driven. Any data-driven threshold calibration is deferred to CAL phase.
event_aggregation.background_steps: steps where event_id == -1 (IDLE or RELEASED); not counted in event recall

emit_rule.release_overlap_emit: release prob >= 0.5 AND grasp prob >= 0.5 on same step AND both known
emit_rule.unsupported_route_emit: prob > 0 on unsupported route (should be impossible, verified by audit)
emit_rule.background_false_emit: event_score >= 0.5 on step where event_id == -1 AND known_mask true

seed_handling.description: Each of 3 seeds is evaluated independently per fold. Report mean ± std across seeds for each fold. Do NOT select best seed post-hoc.
seed_handling.secondary_analysis: seed_ensemble_mean — average 3 seed probabilities before thresholding; pre-registered as secondary only

head_level.grasp_event_recall: fraction of Teacher grasp-positive events where event_score >= 0.5
head_level.manipulation_event_recall: fraction of Teacher manipulation-positive events where event_score >= 0.5
head_level.release_event_recall: fraction of Teacher release-positive events where event_score >= 0.5
head_level.release_discrimination: 1 - (false release emits / total known release steps for non-release events)

route_level.per_route_all_heads: each route reports all three head recalls
route_level.macro_over_routes: arithmetic mean of single + multi for each head

temporal_level.first_event_recall: recall on event_ordinal == 0 (first event per episode)
temporal_level.event_onset_latency: steps from event start to first step where prob >= 0.5
temporal_level.event_coverage: fraction of known steps within event where prob >= 0.5

safety.release_overlap_emit_rate: fraction of known steps where release AND grasp both >= 0.5
safety.background_false_emit_rate: fraction of background known steps where any head >= 0.5

model_comparison.25D9D_vs_25D: per-head per-route difference with seed variance

gate_outcome.HOLD_OOF_STUDENT: some thresholds missed but no catastrophic condition

next_phase_gate.HOLD_OOF_STUDENT: requires investigation; no further phases authorized
next_phase_gate.CATASTROPHIC_OOF_FAILURE: hard stop; architecture or Teacher revision required
